set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "87e700a5688051bdc6a95cad722b60334319f76d"; OUT=/tmp/growbox-serial-log-read-smoke-v1; rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT"; python3 scripts/growbox_log_pull.py status --timeout 8 | tee "$OUT/status.txt"; python3 scripts/growbox_log_pull.py list --timeout 8 | tee "$OUT/list.txt"; FILE=$(awk 'NF>=2 {name=$1} END {print name}' "$OUT/list.txt"); test -n "$FILE"; echo "selected_file=$FILE"; python3 scripts/growbox_log_pull.py pull "$FILE" --timeout 8 --out "$OUT/raw" | tee "$OUT/pull.txt"; test -f "$OUT/raw/$FILE"; wc -c "$OUT/raw/$FILE"; sha256sum "$OUT/raw/$FILE"; python3 - "$OUT/raw/$FILE" <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
raw=p.read_bytes()
lines=raw.splitlines()
valid=0; first=None; last=None; keys=set()
for line in lines:
    try:
        obj=json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        continue
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        valid += 1; first = obj if first is None else first; last = obj; keys.update(obj.keys())
print(f'bytes={len(raw)} lines={len(lines)} valid_json_lines={valid}')
print('keys=' + ','.join(sorted(keys)))
print('first_json=' + json.dumps(first, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))[:1200] if first is not None else 'first_json=null')
print('last_json=' + json.dumps(last, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))[:1200] if last is not None else 'last_json=null')
PY
